description: Western Treatment Plant Carrier and Main Pipelines is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Western Treatment Plant (WTP) is a wastewater treatment facility. This layer contains the WTP carrier and mains and associated details. Includes sewer name, description, asset section (for As Constructed drawings) and key attributes. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are carrier, main, sewer, treatment-plant, wastewater. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
